correctness.rationale: The cited Lucas ambiguity formula is checked against an independent Lucas-index partition enumeration through 1006. The gap-{4,7} argument plus ten checked witnesses in 5K give exact coverage of all N>=1002. 1001 is excluded by both a complete bounded sixfold bitset and symbolic reduction to two sixfold candidate coefficient zeros. The minimal fixed order h=6 follows rigorously from #hK∩[0,X] <= h X/(4+3alpha)+O_h(1)<X for h<=5. Verified Python 3 script operates on exact integers and fully enumerates only the finite certificates.

value.rationale: This gives the least exact additive-basis order and its optimal conductor for the established natural set of integers with nonunique Lucas representations (OEIS A342089), not merely an arbitrary finite slice. The sixfold sharp threshold and fivefold density obstruction together constitute a complete natural classification of fixed additive order and a reproducible exceptional boundary, connecting Fibonacci/Beatty numeration and additive number theory.
